text.en: The Lebanese couple Victor Bichara and Emily Panayotti opened movie houses in Naga in the 1920s, a turning point for the city's cinema business.
The pre-war Bichara Theatre reopened in the early months of 1946, lifting post-war spirits alongside the Alex Theatre and the Almedas' Cine Cita.
By 2023 the Bichara Theatre had become the Bichara Mall, likely the last of downtown's old movie houses still showing films.
